title: Anyone else? It’s always night time, I never see anyone’s face, I never talk to anyone, and I always feel a sense of threat?
content: my mall world is pretty much a whole town. there’s a school (in which I rarely go into the classrooms and spend most of my time in the hallways or the parking lot trying to find my car or get it to start), there’s an old hotel that has a concert/event space, there’s a carnival/fair, there’s a store that i sometimes work at and i can always remember the layout of/where items are, a sort of knock off disney world, and a big abandoned mall (very liminal space vibes, sometimes there’s other people in the mall as well) in my dream universe it feels completely real like an alternate reality or a slightly off version of my own reality. it’s always night time except at the fake disney world. there’s this slightly threatening feeling that follows me everywhere (except for the fake disney world), but especially so in the school and mall, like im not supposed to be in this universe. in my dreams there’s no ‘plot’, im never doing anything. just walking around really. until it “switches” and i feel like something is coming after me and i NEED to get out and i frantically start looking for an escape. in my dreams i also never speak to anyone. i never see their faces. everyone seems to be walking with their heads tilted down to the ground and they walk very slowly while i walk at a pretty normal pace. sometimes im walking with someone or accompanied by someone in my dreams but i still never see their face or talk but it does feel like we’re having a conversation without words. the school seems to be the “hub” of my mall world if that makes any sense, the energy feels strongest there, that’s where I “spawn” most often and where the threatening feeling is the strongest.
